messages.subject: Renjin on java 11
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

As java 8 will reach end of Premier support of Java 8 in march, I have created a java11 branch (https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/tree/j11-beta1) which is based on java11 and also has most of the dependencies upgraded.

I have been running my stuff on this branch for several week now and initially found some things that I've fixed but it has been smooth after that. My usage is perhaps a bit narrow though (I am mainly using base R and mostly various relational database interactions i.e some forecasting, reports with plots etc., various financial calculations etc.) so it would be great if other people would give it a go as well and provide feed-back.

Maybe we could make a special release of it available somehow or I could create a special version of Ride for it... Please let me know if there are any takers and we can figure out together how to make it easily available for testing.

Best regards,
Per

messages.subject: Announcement: Ride version 1.2.7 released
messages.body_plain:
I am pleased to inform you that I just release a new version of Ride, an IDE for Renjin R development.

There are two different versions of Ride in this release
Ver 1.2.7 which is for JDK 8 and using Renjin 3.5-beta76
Ver 1.2.7-jdk11 which is for JDK 11 (or higher) and built from the Renjin j11-beta1 branch
Both can be found here:  https://github.com/Alipsa/ride/releases/tag/v1.2.7

Even though Alex has not released an official beta for java 11, I thought it would be a good idea to make it simple for others to test it so that the chance of getting some feed-back would increase.

Best regards,
Per

messages.subject: lubridate package
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

We are planning to integrate R into our Java web app. We have issues with trying to setup lubridate package that our R code depends on.
Is there consistent way (even using older versions or Renjin or lubridate) to successfully load lubridate package?

Thanks.
